chips.name: Photosynthesis I
chips.description: Obtain 2 energizers every 5 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Photosynthesis II
chips.description: Obtain 3 energizers every 5 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Photosynthesis III
chips.description: Obtain 4 energizers every 5 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Bounty Hunter I
chips.description: Obtain 2 extra energizers for each Zobo you kill within 120 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Bounty Hunter II
chips.description: Obtain 3 extra energizers for each Zobo you kill within 120 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Bounty Hunter III
chips.description: Obtain 4 extra energizers for each Zobo you kill within 120 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Slot Machine 2
chips.description: Randomly obtain 2 Tatari from your formation. If you exceed the deployment limit, randomly upgrade a number of your Tatari equal to the amount exceeded.

chips.name: Slot Machine 3
chips.description: Randomly obtain 3 Tatari from your formation. If you exceed the deployment limit, randomly upgrade a number of your Tatari equal to the amount exceeded.

chips.name: Slot Machine 4
chips.description: Randomly obtain 4 Tatari from your formation. If you exceed the deployment limit, randomly upgrade a number of your Tatari equal to the amount exceeded.

chips.name: AFK
chips.description: Enter mandatory auto-battle mode for 40 seconds and immediately obtain 400 energizers.

chips.name: Water Form I
chips.description: Your Water Tatari gain a 20% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Fire Form I
chips.description: Your Fire Tatari gain a 20% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Grass Form I
chips.description: Your Grass Tatari gain a 20% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Rock Form I
chips.description: Your Rock Tatari gain a 20% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Lightning Form I
chips.description: Your Lightning Tatari gain a 20% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Water Form II
chips.description: Your Water Tatari gain a 30% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Fire Form II
chips.description: Your Fire Tatari gain a 30% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Grass Form II
chips.description: Your Grass Tatari gain a 30% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Rock Form II
chips.description: Your Rock Tatari gain a 30% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Lightning Form II
chips.description: Your Lightning Tatari gain a 30% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Water Form III
chips.description: Your Water Tatari gain a 40% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Fire Form III
chips.description: Your Fire Tatari gain a 40% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Grass Form III
chips.description: Your Grass Tatari gain a 40% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Rock Form III
chips.description: Your Rock Tatari gain a 40% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Lightning Form III
chips.description: Your Lightning Tatari gain a 40% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Glass Cannon
chips.description: All of your Tatari gain 25% ATK, but lose 10% Max HP.

chips.name: Barricade
chips.description: Tatari on your 2 front rows gain 40% Max HP and DEF, but deal 10% less damage.

chips.name: Boss Killer
chips.description: Your Tatari deal 20% more damage to Zobo bosses.

chips.name: The Exile
chips.description: Your Tatari without adjacent allies gain 35% ATK, Max HP, and DEF.

chips.name: First-Aid Kit
chips.description: Tatari on your first 2 rows recover 12% of their lost HP every 4 seconds.

chips.name: Rear Guard
chips.description: Tatari on your last 2 rows gain 30% attack speed.

chips.name: Backend Support
chips.description: Your Tatari with exactly 1 of your own Tatari in front of them gain a 45% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Lawn Care
chips.description: Generate 6 single-use lawn mowers at the bottom of the map. Once triggered, mowers kill 5 non-boss Zobos in front, and deal damage equal to 35% of Max HP to bosses and subsequent non-boss Zobos that are hit.

chips.name: Patch Upgrade
chips.description: Replace all of your deployed Tatari below Lvl 3 with random Tatari from your formation. Replaced Tatari's levels are upgraded by 2.

chips.name: Shuffle
chips.description: Replace your ordinary deployed Tatari with random Tatari from your formation and immediately obtain 600 energizers. Contract Employees stay deployed; their Tatari types are excluded from the replacement pool. Replacements inherit each replaced slot’s position and Horde level.

chips.name: Parting Gift
chips.description: Obtain 40 energizers whenever one of your Tatari is knocked down.

chips.name: Underdog
chips.description: When your element is countered by the enemy, it is considered as countering the enemy instead.

chips.name: New Recruit
chips.description: Raise your deployment capacity by 1 and immediately obtain 250 energizers.

chips.name: Equalizer
chips.description: Reset all your deployed Tatari to Lvl 4.

chips.name: Contract Employee
chips.description: Summon 1 random Tatari from your formation. Your summoned Tatari are fixed at Lvl 3 and will not count toward your deployment limit. They cannot be upgraded nor revived.

chips.name: Center Spotlight
chips.description: Zobo bosses will only appear in the middle 2 columns.

chips.name: Roll of Fate I
chips.description: Obtain another chip of the same tier at random, plus 100 energizers immediately.

chips.name: Roll of Fate II
chips.description: Obtain another chip of the same tier at random, plus 150 energizers immediately.

chips.name: Roll of Fate III
chips.description: Obtain another chip of the same tier at random, plus 200 energizers immediately.

chips.name: On the Move
chips.description: After being moved, your Tatari gain 20% ATK and ATK Speed for 30 seconds.

chips.name: Make Waves
chips.description: River crossing time! Create a river that reduces Zobos' Move Speed by 40% when in it.

chips.name: Weakest Link
chips.description: Your Tatari of the element with the fewest units deployed gain 15% ATK, DEF, and ATK Speed.

chips.name: Count to Five
chips.description: The first time you have 3 Lvl 4 Tatari deployed together, upgrade all of them to Lvl 5.

chips.name: Mission Reset
chips.description: Recall all of your deployed Tatari and obtain 180 energizers for each.
